name: modelctl
author: tjcelaya
description: Local llama.cpp and stable-diffusion.cpp model control plus a live coding-agent list, as three dropdowns in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Segments for the running coding agents, the loaded local model and the image model. Left click opens that group, middle click opens all, right click opens the group's actions.

schema.label: Groups shown, left to right: agents (always), model, image
Agents badge glyph (suggestions: 󰆍 console, 󰞷 >_,  agent, 󱚣 robot)
Model glyph (suggestions: 󰚩 robot, 󰘚 chip, 󰻠 cpu, 󰍛 memory)
